The '''Yunteh Mountains''' were a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin IV]]. It was home to at least one inactive [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]]. The Yunteh Mountains was surrounded by the [[Wayward Jungle]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yunteh Mountains were one of many designated [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
